QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Prelude to Collapse
QuestInfo.0: After a struggle, you defeated the mobile fortress #o9400263#. Return to #p9401533#.
QuestInfo.1: You recovered the key to the ultimate weapon -- but the timeline has changed, and now the weapon's pilot has vanished from history! Travel to Tokyo in 2095, before the war began, and protect the young pilot from the unknown threat.
